description: This file defines the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations, nested classes, and interfaces related to message control, WebSocket communication, plugin extension, and remote connection notifications. The file sets up the structure for message handling, configuration, observer pattern implementation, and thread management for message dispatching.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class implementing message control functionalities, including message dispatching, observer management, configuration, and communication interfaces.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A thread class responsible for dispatching messages in a separate thread context.

classes.name: ICollect
classes.description: Interface for message collection and callback registration.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class holding settings for message control, including network nodes and output options.

classes.name: NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents a network node with NodeId, Port, and Binding information.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Implements remote connection notifications and message callback handling, managing connection states and dispatching attach/detach events.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and forwards them to interested parties.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for message collection.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of message outputs and related resources.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message types for specific categories and modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Provides an iterator over message control settings.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches messages by polling the message client.
